boardChat.assistantUnavailable.en: The board assistant is unavailable right now. Please try again in a moment.
boardChat.assistantUnavailable.zh-CN: 董事会助手暂时不可用。请稍后再试。

boardChat.placeholder.zh-CN: 询问任何关于你公司的问题...

boardChat.quick.companyBriefPrompt.en: Draft a one-page Company Brief for {{companyName}} - include our mission, team roster, and first priorities.
boardChat.quick.companyBriefPrompt.zh-CN: 为 {{companyName}} 起草一页公司简报，包含使命、团队成员和首要事项。

boardChat.quick.firstThirtyDaysPrompt.en: Outline our first 30 days. Break it into weekly priorities with who owns what.
boardChat.quick.firstThirtyDaysPrompt.zh-CN: 梳理我们的前 30 天计划。按周拆解优先事项，并说明每项由谁负责。

boardChat.quick.hiringPlanPrompt.en: Create a hiring plan for {{companyName}}. List the next roles to hire, in priority order, with a short rationale for each.
boardChat.quick.hiringPlanPrompt.zh-CN: 为 {{companyName}} 制定招聘计划。按优先级列出接下来要招聘的岗位，并为每个岗位写一句简短理由。

boardChat.quick.introPitchPrompt.en: Write a short intro pitch for {{companyName}} that I could reuse for investors, customers, or recruits.
boardChat.quick.introPitchPrompt.zh-CN: 为 {{companyName}} 写一段简短介绍话术，可复用于投资人、客户或招聘对象。

boardChat.resizePanes.en: Resize board chat and agent feed
boardChat.resizePanes.zh-CN: 调整董事会聊天和智能体动态宽度

boardChat.selectCompanyDescription.en: Select a company to start chatting with your board concierge.
boardChat.selectCompanyDescription.zh-CN: 选择一家公司，开始和董事会助手对话。

boardChat.streamError.en: The board assistant couldn't respond. Please try again.
boardChat.streamError.zh-CN: 董事会助手无法回应。请重试。

boardChat.welcomeBody.en:
Welcome to **{{companyName}}**! I'm {{ceoName}}, your team lead. I've read through what you shared in the wizard{{missionLine}}

Here are a few things I can help you put on paper right now. Pick one below and I'll draft it for you using everything you told us.
boardChat.welcomeBody.zh-CN:
欢迎来到 **{{companyName}}**！我是 {{ceoName}}，你的团队负责人。我已经读过你在向导中提供的信息{{missionLine}}

下面这些内容我可以立刻帮你整理成文档。选择一项，我会基于你提供的全部信息起草。
